item: R779: a link in a backup is refused, never followed
summary: Category folders that are links (symlink, junction, name-surrogate reparse point) are refused in scan and restore; members checked on the way from the backup root, same-file open with O_NOFOLLOW, device check, moved-inode second look for exFAT/FAT; destination links refused; stated limits: hard links, same-filesystem local racer (any local program on Windows).
